messages.subject: Re: lav...@googlegroups.com
parts: What is shortest way to combine standard errors of standardized parameters across multiple data sets (imputed data).

Why?  You should use SEs to test significance of unstandardized parameter estimates.  Standardized estimates are meant to be used as standardized measures of effect size, not another inferential statistic.  But if you want to loop over the imputations and save the estimates and SEs, you can search the internet for equations to pool point and SE estimates using Rubin's rules.  For example, see p. 6 in http://www2.stat.duke.edu/~jerry/Papers/jasa07.pdf
